title: Towards autonomous normative multi-agent systems for Human-AI software engineering teams
reasoning: The paper centers on 'normative multi-agent systems' (NorMAS-SE) and proposes a cognitive architecture that uses deontic logic (obligations, prohibitions, permissions) to ensure agents comply with 'legal and ethical standards' and 'human values'. This normative reasoning is a core component of the proposed system rather than just a side consideration.
